text.en: Allah is kind, and the Qur'an says that with hardship comes ease. Hard days at school do not last forever. You can talk to a grown-up or a teacher about it.
The Prophet said the best of you are the best to their families, and told us to be gentle with children. Kindness matters at school, too. If you want to learn more, ask a teacher or a grown-up.
